value.title: Metrics buffer grows without bound under sustained load
value.body:
After ~6 hours the exporter process reaches 2 GiB RSS. The buffer never drops samples.

Steps:
1. Run the service with the default config.
2. Send 500 samples/s.

Expected: bounded memory.
